name: synclab
description: An interactive laboratory for multiplayer networking techniques.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @synclab/shared build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @synclab/server dev" "pnpm --filter @synclab/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @synclab/shared build && pnpm --filter @synclab/server build && pnpm --filter @synclab/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @synclab/shared build && pnpm --filter @synclab/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @synclab/web typecheck
